Ultimately, turn attention around to recognize 'the one who knows' (*poo roo*)—that pristine, luminous awareness within which all experience appears and disappears. The physical body may experience aches, and the mind may register passing thoughts, but that pure knowing space is neither tired, nor angry, nor bound by time. It is already at peace.
